newsitem.title: USA: W.Europe turning warmer, showers to continue - WSC.
newsitem.headline: W.Europe turning warmer, showers to continue - WSC.

text.p: Showers are set to continue in western Europe but temperatures should not be as cool as the past week has been, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.

Corn and wheat areas in western Europe will see rain and showers and warmer temperatures, while a building ridge will keep eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union dry this week as very warm temperatures develop there.

WSC's three-to-five day forecast called for showers on Wednesday in western Europe, while Thursday and Friday would see showers in the south of the region and fair weather to the north. Warm temperatures early in the period would turn cooler later.
The British Isles would also have showers on Wednesday, followed by fair weather on Thursday and Friday. Again it would be warm on Wednesday, but cooler again by Friday.
Germany and central Europe would be very warm and dry on Wednesday and Thursday, with a few showers and cooler conditions on Friday.
In Mediterranean Europe, WSC forecast showers and seasonal temperatures in Spain, while Italy and Greece would have fair weather and very warm temperatures from Wednesday to Friday.
